html:
Who we are

A decade of design, delivered on site.

Founded in 2016 by Imtiaz Ahmad, Woodex Interior is a Lahore-based design-and-build company working across corporate offices, retail, hospitality, healthcare and premium residential projects. With more than 200 completed spaces, our work is shaped as much by site experience as by drawing boards.

Design, visualization, joinery and site delivery sit inside one studio, supported by Woodex 3D Studio™ and Woodex Furniture™. That means fewer handovers, clearer accountability and a finished space that matches what was approved.

2016Founded in Lahore by Imtiaz Ahmad
200+Projects completed
4Cities served

Vision and mission

Pakistan’s most trusted design-and-build partner.

Our vision is to be known for precision, accountability and craftsmanship that lasts, for offices, commercial spaces and premium homes alike.

Our mission is simple: design, build and hand over functional, elegant spaces that support business success and modern living, on time, on budget and on brand.

Clear in plan

Every measurement, detail and finish is checked before it is accepted.

Honest in material

Clear quantities, real specifications and no late surprises on the budget.

Precise in delivery

Quality that lasts in daily use, not only quality that photographs well.

On time every time

Every stage has an owner, a date and a visible route to handover.

One accountable team

One studio, one coordinated scope and one standard from first drawing to site.

Built around you

Your space and your goals lead the brief. Our experience shapes the solution.

What we do

Four disciplines, one accountable team.

Interior Design

Commercial and residential interiors, from space planning to finishes.

Fit Out

Site delivery, coordination and completion under a single agreement.

Renovation

Existing offices, shops, clinics and homes reworked with minimal disruption.

Architecture

Residential and commercial architecture, elevations and master planning.

Sectors we have delivered

Experience across the spaces people use daily.

Homes

  • Residential houses and villas
  • Custom kitchens, wardrobes and joinery

Workplaces

  • Corporate and petroleum company offices
  • Co-working and branded workspaces

Commercial

  • Retail shops and showrooms
  • Commercial renovation and fit-out

Hospitality

  • Restaurants and cafés
  • Pharmacies and healthcare spaces
View selected work

Our journey

Built step by step since 2016.

Each stage added capability we previously had to outsource: visualization, joinery and full project delivery.

2016

Woodex Interior founded in Lahore by Imtiaz Ahmad.

2018

In-house 3D visualization added, becoming Woodex 3D Studio™.

2021

Woodex Furniture™ established for custom joinery, kitchens and wardrobes.

2026

Delivery across Lahore, Islamabad, Karachi and nationwide.
